property.value:
PLACEMENT RULES *1. Special Terrain must be placed at least 3 squares from any starting area. *2. Special Terrain can't be placed over squares of different elevations or other Special Terrains. *3. A starting force can only include one Special Terrain. *4. The player not choosing the map gets to place Special Terrain first, before placing objects.
MAP BONUS When placed on the Sporting Arena map, choose a friendly character and modify its defense value by +1 against ranged attacks this game. If this terrain can't be placed, you get the Map Bonus.
SCORING Special Terrain is scored when a player is defeated, whether it was placed or not.
[Trait] Unnamed Ability All squares of the Boxing Ring are clear terrain.
[Trait] Unnamed Ability When a character crosses the ropes in either direction, unless it can ignore hindering terrain for movement purposes, its movement ends immediately. If the character is not completely in or out of the ring, its movement may continue until it is completely in or out of the ring.
[Trait] Unnamed Ability Characters that occupy squares out of the ring modify their attack values by -2 when attacking characters in the ring. Characters that occupy squares in the ring modify their attack value by -2 when attacking characters out of the ring.
[Trait] Unnamed Ability Characters in the ring modify their attack value by +1 when making close attacks.
